title: Change of localized base and localization of the second derived tensor factor
statement: Let $R,A,B,R_p,B_p,D$ be commutative rings with compatible maps $R\to R_p\to A$, $R\to B\to B_p$, $R_p\to B_p$, and maps $A\otimes_R B\to D$ and $A\otimes_{R_p}B_p\to D$ agreeing through the indicated maps from $A,B,B_p$. Let $R_p$ be a localization of $R$ at a multiplicative submonoid $S$, and $B_p$ a localization of $B$ at a multiplicative submonoid $T$. For every integer $i$, complex $Q$ of $A$-modules and models $L$ for $Q\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B$, $K$ for $Q\otimes_{R_p}^{\mathbf L}B_p$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], there is a natural $D$-linear isomorphism $D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}H_L^i\cong D\otimes_{A\otimes_{R_p}B_p}H_K^i$. It preserves localized comparison maps under the identity-on-pure-tensors identification of the two ordinary complexes $D\otimes_A Q$. Naturality means equality for all model morphisms characterized by their universal counits and cohomology identifications. Use the complex and scalar extension conventions of [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. The complex $Q$ is already an $R_p$-complex through $A$; it is not localized again.

proof.text: Construct A tensor_R Bp -> D from the compatible maps from A and Bp using the tensor algebra universal property. Its restrictions to A and Bp are the prescribed maps. Apply second-factor localization to obtain e1 from L to an intermediate (R,A,Bp)-model, and localized-base change to obtain e2 from that model to K. Compose e1 and e2.

The A -> D composites through all three coefficient tensor algebras agree by scalar towers. Equality of these maps yields an ordinary complex isomorphism tau0 fixing pure tensors. Factor the given tau as tau0 followed by tau0 inverse followed by tau. Apply both comparison squares, and use functoriality of homology and associativity to compose them.

For Q -> Qprime, obtain a counit-compatible map between intermediate models and its tensor-linear cohomology map. Apply the two naturality equations to these maps and compose them by associativity. This proves naturality for the original characterized g and h.

theorem derivedTensor_base_second_localization_models
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S Rp]
    (T : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization T Bp] (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
        (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
        (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A Bp Q D),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
            (L.cohomology i) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] Bp) D)).obj
            (K.cohomology i),
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A Bp Q D)
          (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] Bp) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] Bp)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] Bp) D).comp
                (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] Bp))] x) →
          L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            (e Q L K).hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i) ∧
      (∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A Bp Q D)
          (L' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D)
          (K' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A Bp Q' D)
          (δ : L.derived ⟶ L'.derived) (ε : K.derived ⟶ K'.derived)
          (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ L'.cohomology i)
          (h : K.cohomology i ⟶ K'.cohomology i),
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            L'.counit = L.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (L'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} Rp)) ε ≫
            K'.counit = K.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Bp →ₐ[Rp] A ⊗[Rp] Bp).toRingHom).map h ≫
              (K'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (K.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i).map
              (K.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict Rp A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i).map
              (ε.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict Rp A).obj Q')))) →
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map g ≫
            (e Q' L' K').hom =
          (e Q L K).hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] Bp) D)).map h)
